_note: The eight aspiring heroes, as DATA. They used to be produced by calling Hell-TCG's generateAspiringHero(), which rolls a fresh stat block and badge set every run — so gen/heroes.json could never be reproduced byte-identically, and the badges it rolled were Hell-TCG names that do not exist in this game. Frozen here 2026-08-21 so the pipeline is deterministic.
_status: AWAITING REDESIGN. Ruled 2026-08-21: these eight need to be totally redesigned. The names and art below are settled — each is one character, named from its own picture. The STATS ARE A FROZEN RANDOM ROLL and mean nothing; do not price them, do not balance against them, do not treat them as authored. `needsRedesign: true` is on every row and audit.mjs R21 fails the build if it is removed while the stats are still the frozen roll.
_badges: originBadges deliberately EMPTY. The generator rolled Hell-TCG badge names — Faithful, Old, Timid, Personality_Sardonic — and 14 of the 17 do not exist in this game. That is not a bug: COMBAT-DESIGN.md §8 says HoBaT's badges are newly authored and the 238-row Hell-TCG library is a reference, not a port. If these heroes want badges they come from content's own set.
